name: cx-timeline
description: CX Timeline — a timeline and commissioning planner, with its resource calendar, kept in a OneDrive folder

scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build

cxTimeline._comment: updateChannel: where an installed desktop copy looks for updates — the desktop-kit branch, which .github/workflows/kit.yml writes once Checks passes on the default branch. It must be on raw.githubusercontent.com, the one host src-tauri/tauri.conf.json lets the window fetch from. Blank means an installed copy never updates itself.
